subject: Short-term overrun proposal and PO path for FinApps launch
messages:
From: John Rivera <john.rivera@finapps.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected quota spike — need short-term headroom and overrun terms

Hi Chloe,

We launched a marketing test last night and saw a 5x traffic spike on a small subset of endpoints. Our current commit won't cover the throughput for the next 72 hours. Engineering has throttled to keep the product usable, but we need a short-term capacity uplift and an overrun pricing option rather than being throttled.

Key ask:
- Temporary quota increase for 72 hours (roughly +120M tokens)
- A capped overrun rate or blended rate for that window (we need predictable economics to justify the traffic)
- PO flow — we can sign a PO quickly if you can provide an addendum to our current agreement today.

Can Redwood offer a short-term blended overrun rate or credit against a true-up? We value the platform and want to avoid degraded UX for customers.

Thanks,
John Rivera
Head of Platform
FinApps Inc

--
FinApps Ops: ops@finapps.com
From: chloe.martin@redwood.com
To: John Rivera <john.rivera@finapps.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected quota spike — need short-term headroom and overrun terms

John — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the launch traction. We can help.

Immediate plan I propose:
- Temporary +120M token uplift active within 2 hours (subject to credit/PO confirmation)
- Blended overrun rate for the 72-hour window: a single blended per-token price (lower than standard paygo) to avoid spikes in invoicing
- We can formalize via a short addendum (DocuSign) and accept PO; if you can send PO to ops@redwood.com I’ll route it for fast approval.

I'll loop in finance and account exec to confirm numbers and approval path — copying Ben and Marissa.

Can you confirm the exact token estimate for the 72h window and whether you expect sustained elevated traffic after that window? That will affect the blended rate.

—Chloe
Chloe Martin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: chloe.martin@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: FW: FinApps — 72h temporary uplift request (need quick approval)

Team — FinApps hit a 5x spike; they ask for +120M tokens for 72h and a blended overrun price to keep billing predictable. They can do a PO today.

Suggested approach:
- Approve temporary capacity (120M) activated ASAP
- Offer a blended overrun rate of $0.0008/token for the 72h window (their typical paygo is $0.0011/token) and a 50% credit off the overrun if they convert to a 3-month commit within 30 days
- Require PO + signed addendum; invoice as short-term overrun and true-up on next monthly invoice

Notes: their ARR footprint is small but the customer is strategic for our marketplace push. Need sign-off on the blended number and whether credit-for-commit is acceptable.

Attaching: draft temp-addendum (internal redline) — will share final if approved.

—Chloe
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: chloe.martin@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: FinApps — 72h temporary uplift request (need quick approval)

Chloe — I’m good to approve operationally with the following edits:
- Blended rate ok at $0.00085/token (meets margin guardrail)
- Offer a 40% credit on overrun charges if they commit to a 6-month minimum at a modest uplift (this is more defensible from finance)
- Require PO with net-30 or prepay for guarantees — since they can sign today, accept net-30 and add a brief SLA about deactivation if PO bounces

Marissa — legal/compliance ok with addendum language? If so we can spin DocuSign and have ops activate cap.

Ben
Director, Revenue Operations
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: chloe.martin@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 13:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: FinApps — 72h temporary uplift request (need quick approval)

Ben — legal is okay with the addendum language. Two points:
1) Escrow clause: include a 72-hour deactivation notice and an invoice-hold if PO is not received within 8 hours of activation.
2) Audit trail: retain usage logs for 90 days for their procurement audit.

I’ll prep a clean DocuSign addendum naming the blended rate at $0.00085/token and the commit credit clause (40% credit if they sign a 6-month commit within 30 days). Chloe — send this to John and I’ll enable DocuSign.

Marissa
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: chloe.martin@redwood.com
To: John Rivera <john.rivera@finapps.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 23 Mar 2028 08:54:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected quota spike — need short-term headroom and overrun terms

John — quick recap and proposal:

What we can do now
- Activate temporary +120M token uplift within 2 hours of DocuSign + PO receipt
- Blended overrun rate for the 72-hour window: $0.00085/token (flat for the window)
- If FinApps signs a 6-month commit within 30 days we will credit 40% of the overrun charges back as a one-time invoice credit
- Activation caveat: if PO is not received within 8 hours of activation we will provide a 72-hour deactivation notice and pause the uplift

Next steps (to keep the timeline tight)
1) John — send PO to ops@redwood.com (FinApps_PO_2387.pdf is fine)
2) I’ll send DocuSign addendum (temp-overrun-addendum.docx) — Marissa will review and enable signature routing
3) Ops will activate uplift after PO + signed addendum are received

If this works, reply-all with PO attached and I’ll move the DocuSign link.

—Chloe
